Collection of Rough Rock Salt Mineral Specimens Natural Pink Hues 2.6 lbs
This listing includes a collection of rough rock salt mineral specimens, often mistaken for rose quartz due to their pink hues. The stones are unpolished and vary in size and shape, exhibiting natural pink colors with occasional white and reddish-brown inclusions. The material is translucent with a crystalline structure. Some pieces show surface imperfections or mineral deposits typical of raw rock salt. These specimens are in their natural, unprocessed condition and are suitable for collectors, crystal enthusiasts, crafts, décor, or metaphysical uses. Lot weighs approximately 2.6 lbs
